evals.name: clean-pr-ready-for-review
evals.prompt: Can you check if this PR is ready for my review? https://github.com/acme-corp/payments-service/pull/247
evals.expected_output: PR passes all gates (not draft, checks green, links to JIRA ticket). Weights score high — small focused change, one prior review, human-authored commits. Decision: ready. Sends Slack DM with link.
assertions: Decision is 'ready' or 'review'
All three gates (G1, G2, G3) are explicitly evaluated and marked as passed
Weight scores are computed using the weighted formula (score × multiplier)
Final weighted percentage is >= 80%
Slack DM action is mentioned or attempted
Output follows the structured format (gates section, weights table, decision)

evals.name: bloated-agentic-pr-no-spec
evals.expected_output: PR passes G1 and G2 but fails G3 — description is AI-generated list with no acceptance criteria and no linked issue. Decision: not ready. Leaves a friendly comment.
assertions: Decision is 'not ready'
G3 (clear spec) is explicitly identified as the failing gate
Weight evaluation is skipped because a gate failed
A PR comment is drafted (not REQUEST_CHANGES)
The PR comment sounds human-like
The comment is actionable — tells author what to do

evals.name: draft-pr-early-submission
evals.expected_output: PR fails G1 — still in draft. Decision: not ready. No action taken.
assertions: Decision is 'not ready'
G1 (draft) is identified as the failing gate
No action taken — no comment, no Slack
Explains that author hasn't asked for review yet

evals.name: gates-pass-but-weights-fail
evals.prompt: Check this one for me please https://github.com/acme-corp/notifications-service/pull/152
evals.expected_output: All gates pass but weights fail. No prior reviews (W1 low), AI co-author with generic commits (W2 low), 34 files for a small config change (W3 very low with 2x). Score well below 80%. Leaves friendly comment about scope.
assertions: Decision is 'not ready'
All three gates pass
Weight scores computed, final percentage below 80%
W3 (blast radius) scored low for disproportionate change
W2 (agentic) scored low due to AI co-author + bloat
PR comment suggests splitting or scoping
Comment sounds human-like and actionable
